Could not find compatible versions

Because every version of g1 depends on g2 < 2.0.beta
  and g0 >= 2.1.rc1 depends on g1 >= 0,
  g0 >= 2.1.rc1 requires g2 < 2.0.beta.
And because g0 >= 2.1.rc1 depends on g2 > 2.0,
  g0 >= 2.1.rc1 cannot be used.
Because g0 >= 2.0.beta, < 2.1.rc1 depends on g3 < 2
  and g3 < 2 could not be found in rubygems repository @SOURCE@/ or installed locally,
  g0 >= 2.0.beta, < 2.1.rc1 cannot be used.
Thus, g0 >= 2.0.beta cannot be used.
And because g0 < 1.0 depends on g4 < 2.0.beta
  and g4 < 1.0 OR >= 2.A, < 2.0.beta could not be found in rubygems repository @SOURCE@/ or installed locally,
  g0 < 1.0 OR >= 2.0.beta requires g4 >= 1.0, < 2.A.
So, because g0 >= 1.0, < 2.0.beta depends on g4 ~> 1.0
  and g4 ~> 1.0 could not be found in rubygems repository @SOURCE@/ or installed locally,
  version solving has failed.
